maddeler.e:
اختتنوا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَتَنُوا (iḵtatanū) /ix.ta.ta.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
# اُخْتُتِنُوا (uḵtutinū) /ux.tu.ti.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
# اِخْتَتِنُوا (iḵtatinū) /ix.ta.ti.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِخْتَتَنَ (iḵtatana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
